summary: Full E2E validation of the Teacher Overtime Sheet (كشف الساعات الإضافية للأساتذة). Verified policy CRUD, computed values for seeded teachers (باوزير & بن سميط) against the exact expected numbers in the spec, bonus-enabled/disabled behavior, legacy fields, summary totals, sheet-pdf / sheet-excel exports (including two-sheet workbook with 'كشف الساعات الإضافية' + 'المستحقات المالية'), legacy pdf/excel endpoints, teacher scope, and the full UI flow (summary + sheet views + policy modal). 15/16 backend tests passed (1 skipped — the seeded test teacher account is not linked to a teacher record, which is pre-existing data, not a regression). All critical UI testids present and all interactions functional.

issues: Console warnings only (non-blocking): RN-Web deprecated 'shadow*' / 'pointerEvents' style props, Require cycle in HR EmployeeFormModal ↔ HrSelect, several 'Unknown event handler' warnings from Pressable/TouchableMixin. Not caused by this feature; pre-existing RN-Web noise.

critical_code_review_comments: teacher_overtime.py: computed per-teacher fields are nested under teacher['summary'] rather than flat on the teacher object. The review request text implied flat fields (e.g. teacher.weekly_quota, teacher.bonus_hours). Current structure works and is internally consistent (frontend reads t.summary.*), but if any external consumer expects flat fields they will break. Consider duplicating a handful of top-level aliases (weekly_hours, required_hours, bonus_hours, overtime_hours, overtime_amount, hourly_rate) for forward compatibility.

GET /api/reports/teacher-workload for a teacher login whose account is not linked to a teachers document returns 404 with a clear Arabic message — fine, but worth documenting in the API spec so clients can distinguish 'no record' from auth errors.

Default policy state (bonus_enabled=False) means the seeded expectations only hold after enabling the faculty policy. Tests toggle this on at the start of TestReport. If main agent re-runs seed, remember to re-enable the policy (bonus_divisor=6, rates {'أستاذ مساعد':5000,'أستاذ مشارك':6000}) — this is the state the tests leave the DB in.
